overexpression of Phb1 inhibits staurosporine-induced apoptosis in rat granulosa cell cultures via an intrinsic apoptotic pathway, and this effect is mediated by mitochondrial translocation of Phb1.
overexpression of prohibitins in granulosa cell lines inhibits apoptosis by preventing mitochondrial membrane depolarization.
prohibitin inhibits STS and serum deprivation-induced apoptosis in granulosa cell mitochondria.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of prohibitins in the suppression of programmed cell death in rat granulosa cell apoptosis.
the regulation of granulosa cell death in the rat ovary, which has important implications for the control of ovarian function and fertility in women.
the regulation of apoptosis in undifferentiating granulosa cells by prohibitin and its role in the regulation of ovarian function.

Phb1 is a mitochondrial protein that inhibits apoptosis in undifferentiate granulosa cells by suppressing the mitochondrial pathway.
the overexpression of prohibitins in granulosa cell mitochondria suppresses the STS-induced apoptosis via the intrinsic pathway.
the prohibitin protein is a key regulator of granulosa cell apoptosis.
